bullets.text: Sovereign Cloud Scaling - **Azure Local** now supports thousands of nodes for enhanced local workloads and compliance.
Evolving AI Partnership - **Microsoft** and **OpenAI** streamline their collaboration to enhance AI platform capabilities.
Windows Update Control - New features enhance user control over updates, addressing feedback on disruption.
Agentic AI in Office - **Copilot** now offers advanced capabilities in **Word**, **Excel**, and **PowerPoint** for enhanced productivity.
AI-Driven Security - **Microsoft** leverages AI to enhance cybersecurity measures against evolving threats.
Database Modernization Initiative - **Azure Accelerate for Databases** aims to enhance AI readiness through modernization.
Passkey Sync Security - **Microsoft Password Manager** enhances security for syncing passkeys across devices.
